primary_justification: Source-reconciliation evidence supports a bounded calibration patch: the only blocking extra pipeline row is Short-term Investments BlackRock Liquidity T-Fund - Institutional Shares with output fair value 56001000 and no matching current-period raw/XBRL source fact, while the output wrapper already classifies it as family cash and disposition non_private_market rather than a private production position.

html_citations.reason: Coordinate evidence shows the BlackRock Liquidity T-Fund row is visible in the current-period SOI table; HTML is used only for identity and classification support, not as numeric source of truth.

patch_summary: Propose adding an output-only cash or money-market calibration for rows whose wrapper disposition is non_private_market and wrapper family is cash, so retained analytics cash buckets do not become blocking private-position residuals; add a regression for this BlackRock T-Fund shape and a false-positive guard for real loan rows containing cash/PIK coupon language.
source_reconciliation_effect: Expected to clear the single blocking extra_in_pipeline row for this CIK/date while preserving blockers for output rows that are private-market production positions or lack a non_private_market cash wrapper classification.
gav_effect: Context only; GAV already passes and no independent pass/fail claim is made from the proposed patch.
tests_validation_plan: pytest tests/test_bdc_cik_review.py tests/test_bdc_cik_validator.py tests/test_validate_holdings.py; python -m pipeline.main --unified --validate
residual_risk: The diagnosis enum has no exact cash-equivalent/non_private_market bucket value, so ZERO_OR_UNFUNDED_NON_INDEX_ROW is the closest available non-production-position diagnosis. Human merge should verify the calibration does not hide genuine pipeline-only private investments that merely contain cash-related coupon text.
reviewer_notes: The bundle has no source-only blockers for this group. raw_source_rows_current_period and xbrl_rows_same_accession contain no BlackRock Liquidity T-Fund source row, while source_reconciliation_detail_samples identifies the output row as non_private_market/cash with rule ANTARES_PRIVATE_CREDIT_CASH_NON_PRIVATE_MARKET_V1. The HTML coordinate candidate at table 65 row 21 corroborates current-period row identity only.
